manifest.purpose: Golden submission: synthesizable Verilog module crc16_serial implementing CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (polynomial 0x1021, seed 0xFFFF, MSB-first, no reflection, no final XOR). Ports: clk, rst_n, enable, data_in, crc_out[15:0]. Moore-type output: crc_out is registered state, updates one cycle after enabled input. Synchronous active-low reset sets state to 16'hFFFF in same cycle. Must pass cycle-accurate simulation against reference netlist for all test vectors including FR2 (0x31 -> 0xC0A7) and FR3 (0x1234 -> 0xDFB3).
